translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Sarahanda Aisaga taba henenego ogo
Anduane Homogohanda Sara biamogo bulebero lalu abale lo wiyadagua bialu biamogo bini.
Sara ibu gali bere biruwa ibugua Abarahamabi agali wahe heagola igiri mbira taba henene. Ngode Datagaliwabehanda horo ogoningiore taba honolebere lalu abale lo wiyagongiore igiri ogoni taba henene.
Taba hanayagola Abarahamahanda igiri gali ogoni mini Aisaga wini.
Sarahanda Aisaga taba hono bereane horo halira piyagola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda bibe lalu mana lamiyadagua bialu igiri gali ogoninaga dongone poda mabu bini.
Abarahama ibunaga mali handari mbira (100) hayagola ibu one Sarahanda Aisaga taba henene.

Taba honowa Sarahanda lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabehanda i̱ dara halu biamogo biyadagonaga turu ho biruwa oba halu bedogoni. Ainde wali agali mani holebirarume i̱naga bi te ogoni hale howa ti i̱na turu harogoha turu hatago holebira, lene.

Sarahanda la dege bialu lalu, Abale wali agalime Abarahamanaga waneigini mbira Sarahanda taba hono birulubada lagago ai áyu Abarahama ibuni agali wahe kangi i̱na ibu igini mbira taba honowa andu mialu bedogoni, lene.
Igiri biago ibu anda halu wahe howa ibu ai̱ya andu waho heagola Abarahama ibugua turu howa ibu igininaga tomo timbuniore dawene.
Abarahamahanda Hega Isimalela talu pelenego ogo
Iyibi wali Hega ibugua igiri mbira Abarahamanaga ala taba henene. Horo mbirungi igiri ogoni ibu Sara igini Aisagala gini bialu hearia Sara ibu hendene.

Ani hondowa Abarahamahondo lalu, Wali biabe bia haga ogoni ibu igini heba talu pelabe. Garabaya biabe ale bia haga ogoni iginime í̠naga paluni í̠ igini Aisaga ibu hangu hai holene ngago maru ibu mo holigo talu pelabe, lene.
Bi ogoni layagola Abarahama ibu Isimalebi nde ibu igini dege biagoha ibu miniha genda ho hene.

Ani heagola Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Abarahamahondo lalu, Wali garabaya biabe ale bia haga Hega ibu iginilanaga genda nahabe. Wahalu Sarahanda bi larago hale halu bia laradagua bibe. Í̠naga waneigini aguaneru Aisagaha howa hama tagira polebira.
Ainde wali garabaya biabe ale bia haga ogoni igini ibunaga damenebi nde dewa dege holebiragonaga mamali ibu holebira. Ibubi nde í̠ igini dege kagoni, lene.

Horo mendengi egerebagiore Abarahama ibugua tomoru iba be nogo meme dongoneme wabini mbiraha iba hambu to̱lowa Heganaga payani mo ya hene. Ani buwa Abarahama ibugua igiri biago Hega mialu, Libu pudaba, lene. Ani biya handala Hega ibu dindi ko wali agali nahaga Beaseba dindi wiagoha puwa ogoniha ibaga bialu berene.
Ani bialu howa iba biba hayagola Hega ibugua igiri ira tene wiagoha berelene.
Ani berelalu ibu igini homarago nahondole lowa mabu tu mbira ale birule pene. Ani biruwa nde Hega ibu dugu bialu biru wini.

Ngode Datagaliwabehanda igiri biagome dugu biyago hale hene. Hale hayagola dahuliyali mbira dahuliya andaga howa Hegahondo oladali howa lalu, Hega-o agua biyabe. Í̠na gi holene nawi. Ngode Datagaliwabehanda igiri dugu biayuago hale hayago
ai í̠ heyalu puwa igiri gini mule pu. I̱na ibunaga waneigini aguaneneru mo dame bia halu dewaore helolebero, lalu lene.

Ani lowa Ngode Datagaliwabehanda Heganaga de mo ngala hayagola handa amu halu hearia iba biraga uli mbira wiaria hendene. Ani wiaria handalu Hega ibugua abale puwa iba be nogo dongoneme wabini biagoha iba hambu yalu dai buwa ibu igini nelo mini.
Igiri biago Ngode Datagaliwabehanda amu wali agali nahaga wiagoha dege halu anda howa hongoheore hene. Ogoniha howa ibuguaore danda timuru yulenenaga dolomini howa pari wayali hene.
Ibu Parana dindi ko wali agali nahaga ogoniha halu anda hayagola ibu ai̱yahanda Iyibi wandari mbira ibu dabu bilo haru ibini.
Abarahamahanda Habo Nalolene bi Abimelegela lo winigo ogo

Horo ogoningi Abimelegebi ibunaga ami agali haru haga haguane mbira mini Pigolo heagobi libu haru Abarahama hearia puwa ibuhondo lalu, Í̠na bialu keruni damene bibahendeha Ngode Datagaliwabe ibu í̠ heba dege bialu haga kegoni.

Ani haga kegonigo ai í̠na Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni howa heneneore i̱bi i̱ waneigini aguaneneru bababi mo hondo nahe bayale tigabi bulene ngadagua bialu holebero lalu bi ogoni lo wibe. I̱na í̠hondo mana bayale dege bialu haabo harugoni. Anidagua dege í̠na i̱hondobi nde dindi í̠ bai nale o íbu kegoriani howa mana bayale dege bialu holebero lalu lo wibe, lene.
Ani layagola Abarahamahanda ladai bialu lalu, Í̠na bi o laregonidaguaore bulebero, lalu lowini.
Ani lowiyagola howa Abarahama ibugua iba hambiagane uli mbira winigo Abimelegenaga biabe bia haga agali bu hearume ti karulenego ogoni nakarulape biya lalu Abimelege lamini.
Ani lamiyagola Abimelegehanda ladai bialu lalu, Ogoni biyago i̱ manda nabi haruda. Í̠na abale langia nabi áyu dege laregoni hale haro, lene.
Ani layagola Abarahamahanda nogo sibi bulumagaru tale buwa maru Abimelege mialu libugua habo nalolene bi lowini.
Ani lo wialu howa Abarahamahanda ibunaga sibi angibuni hinu hearu aria dalua hearu karia sibi maru heba hearia tale bialu naina dababagi ho helene.
Ani heleagola Abimelegehanda ibuhondo hale halu lalu, Uruni agi bulenaga talebu dababagiho helarebe, lene.
Ani layagola Abarahamahanda ladai bialu lalu, I̱na nogo sibi dalua hinulene egene o ngerogoni irane iba hambiagane uli ogoni heneneore i̱nime wa winigo mo walia halu ngerogoni haru ha, lene.
Nogo sibi biaru mialu howa libu haru habo nalolene bi ogoriani howa lowini. Ani lo winidagoni mitangi bialu dindi ogoni mini Beaseba wini.
Libugua habo nalolene bi ogoni Beaseba dindi ogoriani howa lai halu Abimelegebi ibunaga ami agali haru haga haguane Pigolobi libu haru Pilidia dindiha dai bini.
Ani piyagola Abarahama ibu nde Beaseba dindini howa ira mbira hengene. Ani hongowa Anduane Homogo ibu Ngode Datagaliwabe Haluhe Haabobo Haga kago mitangi bialu lotu lalu hene.
Ani bialu howa Abarahama ibu luore Pilidia dindiha haabo hene.
